firm_data.firm_description: Deloitte Legal is a Law Practice company that provides legal and professional services to develop innovative solutions and create value for businesses. With more than 2,500 legal professionals operating in over 75 countries, Deloitte Legal collaborates seamlessly across borders and with other Deloitte businesses and service lines.
notable_facts: Operates in 57 countries (including Spain, Italy, Germany, United Kingdom, and Poland).

tech_contact.name: John Powers
tech_contact.title: Global Chief Transformation Officer | Chief Information Officer

ai_contact.name: Bruce Braude
ai_contact.title: Deloitte Global Chief Technology Officer – Legal

email.to_title: Global Chief Transformation Officer | Chief Information Officer
email.subject: AI for Deloitte Legal, built for your global footprint
email.body:
Hi John,

Deloitte Legal operates across 57 countries with over 2,500 legal professionals. Managing that kind of distributed expertise while maintaining consistency and quality is exactly the challenge we solve.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms navigating complex, multi-jurisdictional work. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and enabling lean teams to punch above their weight.

As someone leading global transformation and technology strategy, you know the gap between what legacy tools promise and what modern practices actually need. I'd welcome 20 minutes to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping firms compete at scale.

Worth a conversation?

Vasu
Lucio
